hero: Technology headquartered in Florida, built for the world.
lede: MacLorian X Group LLC is a technology company focused on mobile applications and digital platforms in financial education, logistics, and services.
products-lede: Each product solves a concrete problem in its market. They grow in parallel, not depending on a single launch.
prod-deduth-tagline: Your money. Your game. Your level.
prod-deduth-desc: Spanish-language financial education platform for adults. Courses, advisory, and premium content, without jargon.
prod-kids-tagline: Learning about money by playing, from a young age.
prod-kids-desc: Financial education for children ages 6 to 14. Interactive content, games, and short lessons. Designed for COPPA compliance.
prod-traslapp-desc: Transport platform for construction materials — soil, gravel, stone, asphalt. Connects contractors with drivers in SW Florida and worldwide.
prod-app-tagline: Turn your service into a membership.
prod-app-desc: Closed marketplace of subscription-based services. Each provider has their mini storefront with catalog and charges monthly memberships. Pilot market: SW Florida.
about-title: A technology company, headquartered in Florida.
about-1: MacLorian X Group LLC was founded in March 2026 in the state of Florida. We focus on the development, management, and operation of mobile applications, digital platforms, and technology services.
about-2: Our focus is on building useful products for the entire world, with SW Florida as our pilot market. Each division operates as an independent business unit with its own market and metrics, under the corporate umbrella of the holding.
contact-lede: Investors, partners, press, or if you want to collaborate on any of the products — write to us.
footer-meta: Limited Liability Company · Registered in Florida, United States · March 2026
